image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming against a textured red coral background. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and yellow posterior body/tail, with a distinct vertical white stripe separating the two color zones. The eye is large with a blue iris, and the mouth is small and open.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The color pattern matches the species description perfectly: black front half, yellow back half/tail, separated by a white vertical bar. The tail has a dark margin.

The anal fin is visible on the ventral side, mirroring the shape of the posterior dorsal fin.
The caudal fin (tail) is clearly rounded, not forked or truncated.
